notes.title: The Talking Dead: Dyscourse Is Out
notes.notes:
The Hivemind’s assorted ReviewNodes have been subject to a cruel overload this past week, so our optimistic plans to Wot I Think all over conversation-based survival adventure Dyscourse [official site] in time for launch sadly came to naught. Soon, though: John will be turning his attention to it as soon as he’s finished his nine hundred thousand million and twelve hours in Pillars of Eternity. In the meantime, consider this a comparatively timely hey-o, Dyscourse is out nod.
… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Dyscourse is now available!
notes.notes: After two years in development, we're finally launching Dyscourse on Steam! Grab it today! Also, we've launched our Special Edition, which includes a beautiful art-book, a mid-development documentary video, a 77-song soundtrack, and a wallpaper. :)

notes.title: Indies crash on Dyscourse island!
notes.notes:
Watch a group of indie misfits struggle to survive in our bonus scenario, Indie Plane Crash!

Including Tim Schafer (Double Fine), Phil Tibitoski (Octodad), Edmund Mcmillen (Super Meat Boy), Alexander Bruce (Antichamber), Ron Carmel (World of Goo), Robin Hunicke (Journey), Ichiro Lambe (Aaaaa!), Adam Saltsman (Canabalt), Will Stallwood (Auditorium), and Rami Ismail (Ridiculous Fishing).

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/owlchemylabs/dyscourse-survivors-choose-wisely/posts/666104]More info here![/url]
